name: Tensorlake
description: MicroVM sandboxes for AI agents and LLM-generated code that boot in milliseconds, suspend and resume with state, and run desktops, plus durable orchestration and hosted Git.

skills.name: Run Code Sandboxes
skills.description: Create isolated MicroVM sandboxes, run commands and processes, stream output and copy files in and out for agent code.

skills.name: Snapshot and Resume
skills.description: Suspend and resume sandboxes with memory and filesystem preserved, or snapshot and clone them, including running processes.

skills.name: Drive a Sandbox Desktop
skills.description: Launch ubuntu-vnc sandboxes and control their desktop from Python or JavaScript for computer-use agents.

skills.name: Orchestrate Agent Workflows
skills.description: Deploy serverless, crash-resumable agent applications that coordinate sandboxes for long-running workflows.

skills.name: Host Agent Git Repos
skills.description: Create managed Git repositories for agent-generated code, mount them into sandboxes and merge branches via SDK or HTTP.
